test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the word which means the same as the group of words underlined in the given sentence.**

Manisha is a **__believer of fate.__**
solution: The correct answer is **"Fatalist."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"fatalist"** means someone who believes that events are determined by fate and cannot be changed by human actions. (कोई ऐसा व्यक्ति जो मानता है कि घटनाएँ भाग्य द्वारा निर्धारित होती हैं और मानवीय कार्यों द्वारा नहीं बदली जा सकतीं) • **Example:** *It's wrong to take this** fatalist**__'s view of global warming.* • In the given sentence, the word **'believer'** indicates that Manisha has a strong belief in fate. • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Minimalist" **means a person who advocates or practices minimalism, i.e., living with only the bare essentials and avoiding excess. (एक व्यक्ति जो अतिसूक्ष्मवाद की वकालत करता है या उसका अभ्यास करता है, अर्थात, केवल आवश्यक वस्तुओं के साथ रहना और अधिकता से बचना) • **"Socialist"** means a person who advocates for a political and economic theory of social organization that advocates for the means of production, distribution, and exchange to be owned or regulated by the community as a whole. (समाजवादी) • **"Catalyst"** means a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change. (परिवर्तन लाने वाला व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु) 37:T1214, The correct answer is **"An experiment is being studied by Dr. Joyce in his laboratory." (डॉ. जॉयस अपनी प्रयोगशाला में एक प्रयोग का अध्ययन कर रहे हैं।)**
